test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 23 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Out of the four vegetables listed, three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the odd one.
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Vegetables Potato, Beetroot, and Carrot grow below the ground whereas Ladyfinger grows above the ground.

Hence, Ladyfinger is different from the rest.
